brief: Goldman Sachs FICC & Equities' weekly calendar note (Kaplan, Fri Sep 25 2026) previews the week of Sep 28-Oct 2. It states the S&P 500's implied move through Friday Oct 2 is 1.27%, framing the week as macro- and AI-catalyst heavy, with investors watching OpenAI's Dev Day Tuesday and Micron's earnings Friday. US macro data due that week: PCE Wednesday, ISM Manufacturing Thursday, and nonfarm payrolls Friday. Following this week's PMI data, the note reports the market now prices 66% odds of an October Fed hike, up from 53% the prior Friday, attributing the shift to the PMI print rather than arguing an independent thesis. On the micro side, it also lists a run of investor days (MongoDB and Alaska Air Tuesday; Synopsys, Cigna and Hewlett Packard Enterprise Wednesday) and Nike earnings Thursday. The note is a preview/calendar: it reports scheduled events and one market-pricing data point, and does not argue a market view beyond noting the PMI-to-hike-odds link.
